mapper.select: select cast(p.package_id as char) packageId, cast(t.task_id as char) taskId, p.status, p.signed_time signedTime from oa_sign_package_salary_source b join oa_sign_package p on p.package_id=b.package_id and p.employee_id=b.employee_id join oa_sign_task t on t.task_id=p.task_id and t.employee_id=b.employee_id where b.employee_id=#{employeeId} and b.source_id=#{sourceId} order by p.package_id desc limit 20
mapper.sql: s.source_id sourceId, s.employee_id employeeId, s.previous_source_id previousSourceId, s.source_type sourceType, s.business_id businessId, s.batch_id batchId, s.row_id rowId, s.row_version rowVersion, s.file_sha256 fileSha256, s.command_id commandId, s.request_hash requestHash, s.before_hash beforeHash, s.effective_date effectiveDate, s.operator_user_id operatorUserId, s.operator_name operatorName, s.reason, s.verified, s.confirmed_at confirmedAt, s.base_salary baseSalary, s.post_salary postSalary, s.field_allowance fieldAllowance, s.performance_salary performanceSalary, s.salary_total salaryTotal
mapper.select: select from sys_employee_salary_source s where s.batch_id = #{batchId} and s.row_id = #{rowId} and s.source_type = 'HISTORICAL_CONTRACT_EXCEL' order by s.row_version desc, s.confirmed_at desc, s.source_id desc limit 1
select from sys_employee_salary_source s where s.command_id = #{commandId}
select from sys_employee_salary_current c join sys_employee_salary_source s on s.source_id = c.source_id and s.employee_id = c.employee_id where c.employee_id = #{employeeId} for update
select from sys_employee_salary_source s where s.command_id = #{commandId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into sys_employee_salary_source (source_id, employee_id, previous_source_id, source_type, business_id, batch_id, row_id, row_version, file_sha256, command_id, request_hash, before_hash, effective_date, operator_user_id, operator_name, reason, verified, base_salary, post_salary, field_allowance, performance_salary, salary_total) values (#{sourceId}, #{employeeId}, #{previousSourceId}, #{sourceType}, #{businessId}, #{batchId}, #{rowId}, #{rowVersion}, #{fileSha256}, #{commandId}, #{requestHash}, #{beforeHash}, #{effectiveDate}, #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{reason}, #{verified}, #{baseSalary}, #{postSalary}, #{fieldAllowance}, #{performanceSalary}, #{salaryTotal})
insert into sys_employee_salary_current(employee_id, source_id) values (#{employeeId}, #{sourceId}) on duplicate key update source_id = values(source_id)
